Lemon chickpea salad

Crunchy cucumber, chickpeas and a lemony dressing. A fresh answer to the same old lunch.

Prep
~10 min
Method
No-cook
Total
~10 min
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
2

Estimated to serve 2 people as a light meal.

  • For the salad
  • 240 g chickpeas, drained and rinsed
    About 1 standard 15 oz / 425 g can, drained.
    Swap option

    Cooked white beans, drained (240 g)

    Texture: White beans are softer and may break apart more easily.
    Flavor: Milder flavor with a creamier mouthfeel.
    Adjust: Fold gently so the beans keep their shape.
    Prep: Fold gently so the beans keep their shape.

    Use the same drained weight.

  • 1 cup (150 g) diced cucumber
  • 1 cup (150 g) cherry tomatoes, halved
  • ⅓ cup (50 g) crumbled feta
    Swap option

    Diced avocado (50 g)

    Texture: Soft and buttery rather than crumbly.
    Flavor: No saltiness or tang — taste and adjust lemon and salt.
    Adjust: Fold in at the end. Taste and adjust lemon and salt before serving.
    Prep: Fold in at the end. Taste and adjust lemon and salt.

    A suggested variation, not an equivalent cheese replacement.

  • ¼ cup chopped flat-leaf parsley, loosely packed
    Swap option

    Chopped dill, loosely packed (2 tbsp)

    Texture: Same texture — fine, leafy herb.
    Flavor: Dill is more assertive and anise-forward than parsley.
    Adjust: Add with the vegetables, then taste before adding more.
    Prep: Add with the vegetables, then taste before adding more.

    Start with half the parsley volume; add more to taste.

  • For the dressing
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 2 tbsp lemon juice, plus more to taste
  • Black pepper and salt, to taste

Contains milk (feta). Check ingredient labels.

Method

You'll need
Large mixing bowl · Sieve · Knife and board · Whisk or fork · Serving spoon

Prepare

01

Whisk the dressing

Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice in the mixing bowl. Add a few grinds of black pepper.

Look for: The mixture looks slightly cloudy and combined. whisk again if it separates.

Extra tip

Wait until the salad is assembled before adding salt.

Assemble

02

Add the crunch

Drain the chickpeas thoroughly. Add them to the dressing with cucumber, tomatoes and parsley. Toss gently.

Look for: The ingredients look lightly coated, without a puddle of rinse water.

Extra tip

Pat wet cucumber dry with a clean cloth before adding it.

Finish

03

Finish gently

Fold in the feta, keeping some crumbles intact. Taste, adjust lemon and salt if needed, and divide into portions.

Look for: You can still see distinct pieces of feta among the vegetables.

Extra tip

Avoid vigorous stirring, which turns the feta into a creamy coating.

Why it works: Chickpeas bring body, cucumber adds crunch, and lemon keeps the bowl bright.

Serve with

Serve as a light meal, or add bread or a cooked grain for a more substantial plate. These extras are not included in the ingredient amounts.

One way to change it up

For a creamier version, use the avocado option above. The illustration shows the original feta version.

Storage & Prep ahead

For a crisper result, keep the dressing and feta separate from the prepared vegetables until serving. Refrigerate the components in covered containers.

Keep at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Refrigerate within 2 hours of preparation, or within 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Discard if left out longer. This development recipe does not yet have a tested refrigerated shelf life.
